cpmplus.animprops.advanced.desc: Priority, must finish, hide from the wheel, slider steps and the CPM smooth curve.
cpmplus.animprops.prio.desc: Which animation wins when two of them move the same part.
cpmplus.animprops.byteWarn: Priority and order only go from -128 to 127 (game limit). A value outside is set to the nearest limit when you press OK.
cpmplus.animprops.unreachWarn: Hidden from the wheel and not controlled by command: the animation becomes unreachable in game.
cpmplus.animprops.mustFinish.desc: Keeps playing until the end, even after the trigger stops.
cpmplus.animprops.hidden.desc: Only a command can play it. Ticking this also ticks 'controlled by command'.
cpmplus.animprops.maxValue.desc: How many steps the slider has, e.g. 3 = Low/Medium/High (1 to 255).
cpmplus.animprops.interpVal.desc: On: glides between the steps. Off: jumps from one step to the next.
cpmplus.animprops.interp.desc: Only for keyframes set to 'Smooth'. Linear keys export as CPM Linear, Step keys as No Interpolation.
cpmplus.animprops.quality.desc: It is also the keyframe grid of the timeline.
cpmplus.animprops.quality.hint: CPM+ exports your keyframes directly; this quality only matters when the plugin has to recalculate the curve (bezier, formulas, keys off the grid).
cpmplus.animprops.visWarn: A show/hide step lasts less than one frame at this quality: it may vanish in game. Choose a higher quality.
cpmplus.animprops.frameWarn: At this quality the animation passes 255 frames (CPM limit). Choose a lower quality.
cpmplus.animprops.tooManyFrames: At %s frames per second, "%s" would have about %s frames, more than the CPM limit of 255. Choose a lower quality.
cpmplus.animprops.applyAll.title: Apply the quality to all animations
cpmplus.animprops.applyAll.ask: %s animation(s) came from a CPM file and keep their original frames. Change them to %s frames per second too?
cpmplus.animprops.applyAll.done: %s animation(s) now at %s frames per second.
cpmplus.animprops.applyAll.none: Nothing to change: the animations already use %s frames per second.
cpmplus.animprops.estimate.title: Exact size of the animation
cpmplus.animprops.estimate.line: %s: %s frames, CPM interpolator %s, %s parts, about %s KB
cpmplus.animprops.estimate.none: This animation exports nothing (no animated part).
cpmplus.animprops.estimate.note: Real conversion, no file saved. Size = 8 + 20 x parts bytes per frame.
cpmplus.animprops.estimate.saveFirst: Press OK to create the animation first, then open its properties again to calculate.
cpmplus.animprops.layers.menu.desc: Which skin layers CPM uses to sync your animations with other players.
cpmplus.animprops.layers.title: Skin layers for animations
cpmplus.animprops.layers.hint: Only change this if you know what it does: CPM uses these skin layers to sync your animations with other players.
cpmplus.animprops.layers.count: This model has %s animation(s) synced through the skin layers.
cpmplus.animprops.layers.needTwo: %s animation(s) need at least 2 layers marked as switch.
cpmplus.animprops.layers.tooMany: %s animation(s) need more switches: %s layer(s) only fit %s. Mark more layers.
